decisions.reason: The bleaching tray blanks had a dedicated product page in both years, a visible commitment within the firm's core thermoforming materials range, and they cost little to keep in the catalogue, so management will stay the course.

The PETG thermoforming blank had a dedicated page and is central to the firm's established dental laboratory materials portfolio, so dropping it would write off a publicly presented launch with little offsetting gain.

The UV-curing lacquer received only a mention rather than a page of its own, which signals lower commitment, but as a cheap consumable within the existing range it has no clear failure signal that would make dropping it necessary.

Custom hearing protection was only mentioned, and its sister earmold line E was already withdrawn, but it builds on the firm's core custom-device manufacturing and its digital production direction, so management will likely persist.
